_notes: plan (플랜): unified to 'plan' everywhere (marketing tr already uses 'plan'); 'paket' removed from student/mobile.

essay (generic, student app): one term 'yazı' (matches the Writing section 'Yazılar'); 'kompozisyon' removed. 'Niyet mektubu' (personal statement) and 'çalışma planı' (study plan) kept as the established tr terms across all namespaces.
admission letter: 'kabul mektubu'; standard admission letter: 'standart kabul mektubu' (replaces 'kabul belgesi').
consular legalization: 'konsolosluk tasdiki' spelled out wherever the English names it; bare 'tasdik' kept only as the short agency field label (mobile:v3.reviews.legalization).
Every 'danışmanınız' (your counselor) where the English says 'the Hangyul team' was changed to 'Hangyul ekibi'; 'danışman' kept where the English itself says counselor (agency/university strings).
mobile:login.networkError: current text contained developer-only Android-emulator instructions; replaced with the user-facing English meaning.
Placeholders followed by a Turkish suffix were rephrased with 'şuraya ... : {{x}}' or 'tanesi'; {{pct}} assumed to already include the % sign (as in English).
mobile:settings.elsewhere 'Elsewhere' rendered as 'Başka yerde' (section of actions that happen on the web); owner may prefer 'Web'de'.
'Verify document' (agency action) rendered 'Belgeyi doğrula' since the agency marks the document verified; student-facing 'checked' uses 'kontrol'.

Short imperative button labels ('Şimdi başla', 'Seç') kept: standard neutral Turkish UI style, not the 'sen' register; the one true 'sen'-register sentence (mobile:v3.home.noCounselor) was moved to 'siz'.
